text:
Elaine: Hey team — quick sync on Skyward testimonial. Customer interview confirmed for Wed 3/18 10am PT. Need quote sign-off and legal clearance by Tues EOD. Can we do that?
Mike: On it. I have a draft quote, posting now.
Mike: "Skyward reduced inference costs by ~42% after switching to Redwood Dedicated; latency improved from 250ms to 90ms for key endpoints." Thoughts?
Sophia: Love the numbers. Can we change 'after switching to Redwood Dedicated' to 'after migrating to Redwood Dedicated GPUs' — legal likes specifics.
Tara (Legal): Pinged. Need to confirm they approve the exact phrasing. Also confirm we aren't using customer revenue numbers. Did they agree to "reduced inference costs" language in the consent form?
Jordan: They verbally approved the cost percentage but not the exact wording. I can follow up in the interview and ask for explicit sign-off. @Sam (CS) can you route the contact?
Sam (CS): Yep. I'll reach out and get written approval copy into GDrive + sign-off email. Also setting up lead routing: new case-study form will create an inbound lead tagged 'skyward-cs' in Salesforce and notify growth@redwood.
Elaine: Perfect. For the webinar mention — do we want to include Skyward as a co-presenter or just a short customer clip? Budget says 15 min clip + 5 min live QA.
Mike: Let's do a short pre-recorded clip and invite them to the live Q&A. Less risk.
Sophia: Draft messaging for the landing page:
```
Headline: Cut inference costs without sacrificing latency
Blurb: Learn how Skyward scaled language features using Redwood Dedicated to hit production SLAs and reduce per-token cost.
CTA: Watch the case study + register for webinar
```
Elaine: Nice. Tara, once we have signed quote text, can legal approve the landing page copy and the press release excerpt by Wed noon?
Tara (Legal): I can review after sign-off email comes in. Please make sure to attach the exact quote and the screenshot/transcript you intend to publish.
Jordan: I'll add a short transcript capture step to the interview runbook and a recording consent checkbox.
ops-bot: Reminder: set deadline tickets — marketing/CS/legal review due 1769200000 (unix ts) :bell:
Sam (CS): Follow-up scheduled. I'll post confirmation here when I have the signed email.
Elaine: Thanks everyone. If we get sign-off, I'll slot the case study for the April 8th product update post and the April 15th webinar. :thumbsup:
